name: Flowers
source:
You are a young man who has recently crossed the threshold into adult life. Over the past few years, you have primarily focused on education and work. However, recently you made the decision to take a vacation and relax.

And now, as you explore the world beyond work, you realize that life offers much more than just work. You start paying attention to other aspects of your life, such as relationships with women. You discover that your relationships with women you have known before can evolve into something greater.
